headline: Knife attack at a school in Ostroleka, Poland, wounds students and teachers; 19-year-old held
headline_es: Ataque con arma blanca en una escuela de Ostroleka, Polonia, hiere a alumnos y docentes
caption_es: Al menos ocho personas, entre ellas alumnos y docentes, resultaron heridas el miércoles cuando un atacante usó un objeto punzante en una escuela de la ciudad polaca de Ostroleka. La policía detuvo poco después a un hombre de 19 años. La fiscalía no ha revelado un móvil y la escuela permanecerá cerrada durante la investigación.
caption_en: At least eight people, including students and teachers, were wounded on Wednesday when an attacker used a sharp tool at a school in the Polish town of Ostroleka. Police arrested a 19-year-old man shortly afterwards. Prosecutors have not disclosed a motive, and the school will remain closed during the investigation.
summary_es: Al menos ocho heridos, entre alumnos y docentes, en un ataque en una escuela de Ostroleka. La policía detuvo a un joven de 19 años; el móvil se desconoce.
summary_en: At least eight people, students and teachers among them, were hurt in an attack at a school in Ostroleka. Police arrested a 19-year-old; no motive given.
